d:
Somewhere on a desert planet, an explorer is wandering the wasteland. She encounters an organism on the ground and inspect it. Upon touching it, the organism sprout its tentacles and take control of her body. Unable to fight back, she just helplessly watch as the the tentacles from the parasite enter her body and use it as a seedbed...
